## SNR: none




<br><br>

### ROI: frontocentral (averaged)

Here, we averaged the responses across 9 frontocentral channels in the time domain (equivalent to averaging the complex DFT) 
before computing the RDM.   

The channels are: 
    'F1'
    'Fz'
    'F2'
    'FC1'
    'FCz'
    'FC2'
    'C1'
    'Cz'
    'C2'

<br> 

```{r include=FALSE}
roi_str <- 'roi-front_avgChans-true'
```


```{r}

out = NULL

fig_fname_stems <- c('feat-ampSum_topo', 
                     'mX', 
                     'feat-X_method-pearson_nCateg-2_perm', 
                     'feat-X_method-pearson_nCateg-2-3_perm')

output_sizes_prc <- c(100, 40, 60, 60)

out <- knit_templ_over_subjects_summary(subjects,
                                        templ_fname, 
                                        out, 
                                        fig_fname_stems=fig_fname_stems, 
                                        output_sizes_prc=output_sizes_prc)


```

`r paste(knitr::knit(text=out), collapse='\n')`
